title: Bird detection event v1
description: Published on txori/v1/{station_id}/detections with QoS 1 and retain false. Consumed by ingest and by the LCD station. It NEVER carries audio: additionalProperties is false precisely so that a field with samples, base64 or a file path is rejected by the contract and not by a manual review.

observed_at.description: Start of the analysed audio window. It is the observation instant, not the publication instant: a resend does NOT change it.

window_end.description: End of the analysed window. It must be strictly later than observed_at; that comparison is applied by the validator, not by the schema.

scientific_name.description: Taxonomic identifier of the event. It is never replaced by a common name: ES, EU and EN names are resolved through a versioned catalogue in the consumer.

taxon_key.description: PROVISIONAL. Stable key of the taxonomic catalogue. Optional until David confirms which key BirdNET exposes (see docs/interfaces.md). It will become required with schema_version 1.1 if confirmed.

confidence.description: Model score between 0 and 1. It is NOT a calibrated probability nor a definitive identification, and must be presented as such on the LCD and dashboards.

version.description: Exact version of the model that produced the score. Without it an old detection cannot be compared with a new one.
